lines.zh: 菌盖在背上一颠一颠，孢子撒了一路。
lines.en: My cap bobs with each wingbeat and spores trail behind.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀是两片菌膜，扇起来没有声音。
lines.en: My wings are two membranes of fungus and beat in silence.

lines.zh: 秘境的雾很厚，我贴着雾面滑行。
lines.en: Mysterium's fog is thick; I glide just above it.

lines.zh: 我飞得不快，但从不走直线。
lines.en: I fly slowly, and I never take a straight line.

lines.zh: 每条孢子痕迹都是我留下的路标。
lines.en: Every spore trail I leave is a signpost for myself.

lines.zh: 菌褶里存着风，一振翅就放出来。
lines.en: My gills store wind, released with one wingbeat.

lines.zh: 我绕开蘑菇林最高的那几棵。
lines.en: I keep clear of the tallest mushrooms in the wood.

lines.zh: 我的重量几乎全在那顶菌盖上。
lines.en: Nearly all my weight sits in that cap.

lines.zh: 飞过水面时，孢子会浮成一层白雾。
lines.en: Crossing water, my spores float off as a white haze.

lines.zh: 我在树与树之间穿行，像一片会动的菌。
lines.en: I weave between trunks like a fungus that learned to move.

lines.zh: 翅膀破了还能飞，只是会打转。
lines.en: A torn wing still flies, it only spirals.

lines.zh: 别跟我的航线，孢子会呛到你。
lines.en: Do not follow my route; the spores will choke you.

lines.zh: 我往亮处飞，那里孢子散得更快。
lines.en: I fly toward light, where spores scatter faster.

lines.zh: 一天飞下来，菌盖边缘会卷起来。
lines.en: After a day of flying, my cap edge curls.

lines.zh: 我把身子压低，穿过菌丝网。
lines.en: I press low and thread the mycelium web.

lines.zh: 我停在一朵大蘑菇上，喘口气。
lines.en: I perch on a big mushroom and catch my breath.

lines.zh: 我停在蘑菇伞下，把自己也当成一朵。
lines.en: I rest under a mushroom and pass for one myself.

lines.zh: 孢子慢慢落下来，落回我自己的盖上。
lines.en: Spores drift down and settle back on my own cap.

lines.zh: 秘境的光是紫的，照得菌褶发亮。
lines.en: Mysterium's light is violet and makes my gills shine.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，蚂蚁会爬上来。
lines.en: When I hold still, ants climb onto me.

lines.zh: 菌盖下面很凉，像一小片阴天。
lines.en: Under my cap it is cool, a small patch of overcast.

lines.zh: 我在等风，风来了我才有力气。
lines.en: I wait for wind; only wind gives me strength.

lines.zh: 有些孢子飘走了，我数不清少了多少。
lines.en: Some spores drift away and I cannot count the loss.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖翅膀，抖下一层白粉。
lines.en: I shake my wings and a layer of white powder falls.

lines.zh: 静着的时候，我听见菌丝在长。
lines.en: In stillness I hear my mycelium growing.

lines.zh: 这棵树老了，正适合我挂着。
lines.en: This tree is old, which suits hanging well.

lines.zh: 我把菌盖歪向有光的一边。
lines.en: I tilt my cap toward the brighter side.

lines.zh: 没人来的时候，我就练习收翅。
lines.en: When nobody comes, I practise folding my wings.

lines.zh: 你身上没有菌丝，我看了很久。
lines.en: You carry no mycelium, and I studied that for a while.

lines.zh: 我在你头顶转，找能落脚的凸起。
lines.en: I circle your head, hunting a ledge to land on.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸把孢子吹开了，谢谢。
lines.en: Your breath pushes my spores aside; thank you.

lines.zh: 我盯着你手里的火把，太亮了。
lines.en: I stare at your torch; it is far too bright.

lines.zh: 你抬头时，我已经绕到你耳后。
lines.en: By the time you look up I am behind your ear.

lines.zh: 我歪着菌盖，是在听你脚步的节奏。
lines.en: My tilted cap listens to the rhythm of your steps.

lines.zh: 你的披风很宽，像另一片菌盖。
lines.en: Your cloak is broad, like another mushroom cap.

lines.zh: 我看了你两眼，就决定从上面来。
lines.en: Two glances and I decide to come from above.

lines.zh: 别拿手挡，孢子会落在你袖子上。
lines.en: Do not raise a hand; spores will land on your sleeve.

lines.zh: 你站的位置正好在我影子里。
lines.en: You are standing exactly inside my shadow.

lines.zh: 菌盖被削掉一块，孢子全撒了。
lines.en: A slice of my cap is gone and my spores spill out.

lines.zh: 疼，可我的翅膀还在扇。
lines.en: It hurts, yet my wings keep beating.

lines.zh: 你打中的是菌褶，那里最软。
lines.en: You struck my gills, the softest place I have.

lines.zh: 我歪着飞了一段，才重新稳住。
lines.en: I flew crooked for a while before steadying.

lines.zh: 我的菌盖裂了，颜色也淡了。
lines.en: My cap is split, and its color has faded.

lines.zh: 别补第二下，我会记住你的。
lines.en: Do not strike again; I will remember you.

lines.zh: 这一下让我掉了半层粉。
lines.en: That blow cost me half a layer of powder.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀破了个洞，风从里面漏。
lines.en: A hole in my wing lets the wind through.

lines.zh: 我发出很轻的嘶声，你听不见。
lines.en: I hiss very softly, too softly for you to hear.

lines.zh: 还能飘，就不算输。
lines.en: If I can still drift, I have not lost.

lines.zh: 你举着腐木，我倒是有兴趣。
lines.en: You hold up rotten wood, and that does interest me.

lines.zh: 我不吃面包，我吃烂掉的东西。
lines.en: I do not eat bread; I eat what has rotted.

lines.zh: 那块木头上的菌丝比你的手更熟。
lines.en: The mycelium on that wood is more familiar than your hand.

lines.zh: 你把东西放下，我才肯靠近。
lines.en: Put it down, and only then will I come closer.

lines.zh: 我不馋你的食物，我馋木头里的湿气。
lines.en: I do not want your food, I want the damp inside wood.

lines.zh: 举高一点，我就当你是在给我搭架子。
lines.en: Hold it higher and I will take it as a perch built for me.

lines.zh: 你的口袋里有什么在发潮，我闻到了。
lines.en: Something in your pocket is going damp; I can smell it.

lines.zh: 我不抢，我只等它自己烂。
lines.en: I do not snatch; I wait for it to rot on its own.

lines.zh: 诱惑对我有限，菌盖比面包重要。
lines.en: Temptation reaches me weakly; a cap outranks bread.

lines.zh: 你晃了半天，我只想落在你手上歇歇。
lines.en: You wave it about, and I only want to rest on your hand.

lines.zh: 我的菌盖撞到你，撒了你一身孢子。
lines.en: My cap hits you and dusts you with spores.

lines.zh: 对不起，我不会急停，只会歪着躲。
lines.en: Sorry, I cannot stop short; I can only swerve.

lines.zh: 撞上时是软的，孢子先散开。
lines.en: The impact is soft, and the spores scatter first.

lines.zh: 我被你顶得翻了个身，翅膀还在扇。
lines.en: You knock me into a roll, wings still beating.

lines.zh: 别拍衣服，那些孢子只是睡着了。
lines.en: Do not brush your clothes; those spores are only sleeping.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，像两朵菌碰了碰。
lines.en: We bump like two mushrooms nudging each other.

lines.zh: 我退开一点，菌盖上的粉就落下来了。
lines.en: I draw back and powder falls from my cap.

lines.zh: 你挡住我的航线了，我绕不过去。
lines.en: You are blocking my flight line and I cannot go around.

lines.zh: 碰撞之后，菌褶里会掉出一小片。
lines.en: After a collision a small piece drops from my gills.

lines.zh: 我不是撞你，是风把我推歪了。
lines.en: I did not hit you; the wind pushed me off course.

lines.zh: 秘境里菌盖相碰，就是我们的招呼。
lines.en: In Mysterium, touching caps is how we greet.

lines.zh: 我把孢子撒得远一点，等风带回来。
lines.en: I cast my spores wide and wait for the wind to return them.

lines.zh: 同类在雾里，我看不清它有几个褶。
lines.en: My kin in the fog, I cannot count their gills.

lines.zh: 我们不筑巢，林子本身就是巢。
lines.en: We build no nest; the wood itself is the nest.

lines.zh: 两顶菌盖并在一起，颜色会变深。
lines.en: Two caps pressed together deepen in color.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣可能只是另一片会飞的菌。
lines.en: My mate may be nothing but another flying fungus.

lines.zh: 孢子落下的地方，明年会长出新的。
lines.en: Where the spores fall, new ones rise next year.

lines.zh: 我们分开飞，这样孢子才散得开。
lines.en: We fly apart so the spores can spread.

lines.zh: 我不唱歌，我用菌褶的振动打招呼。
lines.en: I do not sing; I greet with a tremor of my gills.

lines.zh: 别打扰，我们正在交换孢子。
lines.en: Do not interrupt; we are exchanging spores.

lines.zh: 我落下去衔一块湿木，又飞起来。
lines.en: I drop to take a wet splinter, then lift again.

lines.zh: 地上的菌丝会缠住我的翅尖。
lines.en: Mycelium on the ground snags my wingtips.

lines.zh: 我把小东西藏进菌盖下面。
lines.en: I tuck small things beneath my cap.

lines.zh: 那块腐木比看起来重，我差点栽了。
lines.en: That rotten wood is heavier than it looks; I nearly fell.

lines.zh: 我不捡宝贝，我只捡能长菌的。
lines.en: I collect nothing precious, only what can grow fungus.

lines.zh: 有东西掉下来，我先绕两圈看看。
lines.en: Something fell, so I circle it twice before landing.

lines.zh: 我的爪子很短，抓不住太圆的东西。
lines.en: My claws are short and cannot grip anything too round.

lines.zh: 捡起来的东西，多半又会在半路掉。
lines.en: What I pick up usually falls again halfway.

lines.zh: 你掉的那块木头，归我了。
lines.en: That wood you dropped belongs to me now.

lines.zh: 我衔着东西飞不高，这是代价。
lines.en: Carrying something keeps me low; that is the price.

lines.zh: 你走进菌林，孢子先替我认出了你。
lines.en: You enter the fungal wood, and my spores name you first.

lines.zh: 我看见一个会动的东西，就在那。
lines.en: I see something moving, right there.

lines.zh: 目标确定了，就在那片紫光下面。
lines.en: Target fixed, there beneath that violet glow.

lines.zh: 我在雾里绕到你背后，你看不见我。
lines.en: I round your back inside the fog, unseen.

lines.zh: 你踩断的树枝，把位置告诉了我。
lines.en: The twig you snapped told me where you are.

lines.zh: 就是你了，你的热气在雾里很明显。
lines.en: You will do; your warmth stands out in the fog.

lines.zh: 我的菌褶开始发烫，这是要俯冲了。
lines.en: My gills grow warm, which means a dive is coming.

lines.zh: 别跑，你跑不过我这种飘着的。
lines.en: Do not run; you cannot outrun something that drifts.

lines.zh: 从上面看，你像一个会走路的树桩。
lines.en: From above you look like a walking stump.

lines.zh: 我已经记住了你的味道。
lines.en: I have already memorized your smell.

lines.zh: 我在树冠上方等你抬头。
lines.en: I wait above the canopy for you to look up.

lines.zh: 风往你那边吹，孢子会先到。
lines.en: The wind blows your way; my spores arrive first.

lines.zh: 再靠近一点，我就能落准了。
lines.en: A little closer and my landing will be exact.

lines.zh: 我压低菌盖，把自己藏进影子里。
lines.en: I lower my cap and hide inside the shadow.

lines.zh: 你的护甲挡住了脖子，可惜挡不住头顶。
lines.en: Your armor guards your neck but not the top of your head.

lines.zh: 数三下，我就从这片雾里下来。
lines.en: Count three and I come down out of this fog.

lines.zh: 我换了两次位置，你都没发现。
lines.en: I moved twice and you noticed neither.

lines.zh: 别往上看，那会让你更慌。
lines.en: Do not look up; it will only unsettle you more.

lines.zh: 菌膜绷紧了，声音小得听不见。
lines.en: My wing membrane tightens, too quietly to hear.

lines.zh: 你转身的瞬间，正好是我下去的时机。
lines.en: The instant you turn is when I descend.

lines.zh: 我整个身体砸下去，菌盖先着地。
lines.en: I drop with my whole body, cap hitting first.

lines.zh: 八点伤害，听起来比看起来疼。
lines.en: Eight damage, and it hurts more than it looks.

lines.zh: 撞完我弹起来，孢子糊了你一脸。
lines.en: I bounce off and spores smear across your face.

lines.zh: 我的爪子只够抓一下，但够了。
lines.en: My claws manage one rake, and one is enough.

lines.zh: 你被撞退时，我已经滑到侧面。
lines.en: As you stagger back I am already at your flank.

lines.zh: 别擦脸，孢子已经进你衣领了。
lines.en: Do not wipe your face; the spores are in your collar.

lines.zh: 这一撞让我掉了一角菌盖，值得。
lines.en: That impact cost me a corner of cap, and it was worth it.

lines.zh: 我不追第二下，我等你乱了再来。
lines.en: I do not follow up; I wait until you are clumsy.

lines.zh: 空气被我的翅膀切开，声音很闷。
lines.en: My wings cut the air with a muffled sound.

lines.zh: 你挥空了，我借你的风飘上去。
lines.en: You miss, and I ride the wind of your swing upward.

lines.zh: 我从一株老蘑菇的褶里挣出来。
lines.en: I work my way out of an old mushroom's gills.

lines.zh: 秘境的雾里，多了一顶会飞的菌。
lines.en: In Mysterium's fog there is one more flying cap.

lines.zh: 孢子落在这里，我就长在这里。
lines.en: The spores landed here, so here I grew.

lines.zh: 翅膀还湿着，我得先晾一会儿。
lines.en: My wings are still wet; I must dry them first.

lines.zh: 四周全是同类，分不清谁是谁。
lines.en: My kind surround me and I cannot tell us apart.

lines.zh: 我第一次飞，撞了三次树。
lines.en: On my first flight I hit three trees.

lines.zh: 紫光下，我的菌盖慢慢张开。
lines.en: Under the violet light my cap opens slowly.

lines.zh: 我从地里的菌丝上被风吹起来。
lines.en: The wind lifted me off the mycelium in the soil.

lines.zh: 这片林子空了一角，正好给我。
lines.en: A corner of this wood stood empty, and it fits me.

lines.zh: 别踩脚边那丛白的，那是我家。
lines.en: Do not tread on that white patch; it is my home.

lines.zh: 火一碰菌盖，我整只都亮了起来。
lines.en: Fire touches my cap and my whole body glows.

lines.zh: 菌膜兜不住风，我一直往下掉。
lines.en: My membranes cannot hold the wind and I keep falling.

lines.zh: 孢子在水中胀开，我沉得更快了。
lines.en: My spores swell in the water and I sink faster.

lines.zh: 冲击波把我的菌盖掀翻过去。
lines.en: The blast folds my cap backward.

lines.zh: 箭穿进菌盖，带出一串白粉。
lines.en: An arrow pierces my cap and drags out a string of white dust.

lines.zh: 那道光让我的菌丝全部缩紧。
lines.en: That light makes all my mycelium clench.

lines.zh: 我饿的其实是木头，不是你的肉。
lines.en: What I starve for is wood, not your flesh.

lines.zh: 雷劈在菌盖上，我闻到烧焦的味。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my cap and I smell burning.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有风，我连滑都滑不动。
lines.en: The void has no wind; I cannot even glide.
